title: From Causal Graphs to Markovian States: Multi-Order State Exposure for Deep RL
abstract: arXiv:2605.07057v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) relies on the Markov property for guaranteed performance, but real-world applications often lack well-defined states given raw observed variables. While causal RL has attracted growing interest, existing work typically assumes Markovian states are provided and uses causality only to accelerate learning. This leaves a fundamental gap: \emph{given a longitudinal causal graph over observed variables, how does one construct MDP states that provably satisfy the Markov property?} We provide a procedure that constructs a provably minimal such state. In deep RL, the minimal representation alone empirically fails to improve performance, indicating that neural networks cannot automatically exploit Markovian minimality. translated_title: 从因果图到马尔可夫状态：面向深度强化学习的多阶状态暴露
translated_abstract: 在线强化学习（RL）依赖于马尔可夫性质来保证性能，但现实应用中仅凭原始观测变量往往缺乏良定义的状态。尽管因果强化学习受到越来越多的关注，现有工作通常假设马尔可夫状态是给定的，而仅将因果性用于加速学习。这留下了一个根本性的空白：给定一个关于观测变量的纵向因果图，如何构造可证明满足马尔可夫性质的MDP状态？我们提供了一种构造可证明的最小此类状态的方法。在深度强化学习中，仅有最小表示在实证上并不能提升性能，这表明神经网络无法自动利用马尔可夫最小性。因此，我们提出了MOSE（Multi-Order State Exposure，多阶状态暴露），将单个共享的Q函数同时暴露于1阶到W阶的基于历史的状态构造中，通过注意力机制……
tldr: 提出MOSE方法，将单个共享Q函数同时暴露于1到W阶基于历史的状态构造，解决了如何从纵向因果图构造可证明满足马尔可夫性质的最小状态这一根本问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes MOSE (Multi-Order State Exposure), which exposes a single shared Q-function to history-based state constructions of orders 1 through W simultaneously, solving the fundamental problem of constructing provably minimal Markovian states from a longitudinal causal graph.
